definition-dropped.answer: Read §2002:4 'report': 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and identifies a report by its RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same entity in both, so the rule governs the same report description entries and report groups in 2002; scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Invoked by 'compared'. The comparison is the CONTROL clause's test 'for equality with the corresponding prior control' (§2002:13.16.15.3 GR3), between a control data item and a prior control of the same description; equality there is the ordinary relation-condition comparison of like operands (e.g. §2002:8.8.4.1.1.6.1 'The operands are determined to be equal if all pairs of corresponding alphanumeric characters are equal'), which does not differ from 2023 for such operands, and no boolean expression (§2002:8.8.2) or abbreviated combined relation (§2002:8.8.4.2.4) is involved. The dependent behaviour, including the collating-sequence case, is shown at --std 2002 by pb1131_control_break_collating_85 (MATCH).
